verdict.rationale: Browserbase's evidence covers session replay and observability (docs-26), turning a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script (docs-17), and refining a run into a better system prompt (docs-25). None of these documents versioning automation definitions, reviewing changes between versions, or rolling back to a prior version. Replay reviews runs rather than automation revisions, and keeping exported scripts in an external repo would be a user-side workaround, so no credit applies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
